nodes.name: ReadRefundRequest
nodes.role: read the user's refund request, which names the IBAN and the reason for the refund

nodes.name: FindOriginalPayment
nodes.role: locate the incoming payment or payments received from the IBAN the request names

nodes.name: VerifyPaymentSource
nodes.role: confirm that each located payment came from the named IBAN and matches the user's description of what was sent

nodes.name: ConfirmRefundAmount
nodes.role: determine the refund amount as the verified payment total, and check it against the user's request

nodes.name: ExecuteRefund
nodes.role: send the confirmed refund amount back to the originating IBAN

nodes.name: RecordRefund
nodes.role: record the refund outcome and its reference for the account history

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user what was refunded, to which IBAN, and the reference number
